description: One Grove (AI) key minted ahead under the trial team for one Product Trial and held here with its secret, until a site of that product takes it into its site config as ai_keys. Revoked once the site is archived or Revokes Automatically After days have passed since it took it.

fields.description: Available until a site of its product takes it (Assigned). Revoking once the site is archived, its days have passed or Revoke Key is clicked, Revoked when Grove confirms.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The key's name at Grove; its title there is this record's id.
fields.label: Grove Key

fields.description: The Product Trial whose sites this key is for, set at the mint.
fields.label: Product Trial

fields.description: What the key may spend for its life, as Grove minted it from Trial Key Cap; Raise Cap lifts it while the site runs.
fields.label: Cap (USD)

fields.description: The Grove Team the key was minted under, Grove Settings' trial team at the time; the revoke names it.
fields.label: Team

fields.description: One key per site, ever: the site that took this key.
fields.label: Site

fields.description: The Product Trial Request whose Site Created took this key.
fields.label: Product Trial Request
Assigned At
fields.description: Press revokes the key once Grove Settings' Revokes Automatically After days have passed from this, whatever the site does.
What Grove answered the last revoke that failed; cleared once one lands. The Error Log has the traceback.
fields.label: Last Error

fields.description: Held for the site's config; the site config is where the key lives.
fields.label: API Key

name: Grove Trial Key
